No post has a report spam button, or any other button for that matter.

Some interfaces (newsreaders) have buttons for "reply" "follow-up" and
so on, but these are not part of the posts.

And some interfaces, like Google News Reader, also have a "report as
spam" button.

Using that button will report the message to Google, who may, if
reports warrant it, limit Google-interface-users' access to that post.
(That's the "one server" example above).

But they cannot do anything about how the post is handled by other
news servers / news readers.
